stylePrefix: Warm children's picture-book gouache matching GourmetProject timeline tokens, as a 30-pixel timeline token. Large color masses only, 2 or 3 solid tones per object, matte paint, slightly irregular dark-brown contour. Hand-drawn, very concise. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.

typePromptPrefixes.ui: Image 1-3 are style masters only: same circular cream disc filling the square canvas, one thin dark-brown rim, same paint thickness. Do not copy their stall, cloche, or chicken subjects. One huge centered food object. Hard rule: no tiny color patches, no dots, no specks, no garnish, no steam, no letters. Every painted region must stay clear at 30 pixels. Outside the circle is only perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta. No face, no eyes, no mouth, no character, no typography. NOT a cake unless the prompt says steamed bun.
